faqSchema.source:
The treatment is done under local anaesthetic and most people find the appointment much easier than the toothache that brought them in. Everyone is different and no dentist can promise a completely pain-free appointment, but the procedure itself is not the ordeal its reputation suggests.

One or two for the root canal itself, depending on the tooth and the degree of infection, plus a further appointment if a crown is planned. Molars generally take longer than front teeth.

Extraction costs less on the day. Replacing the tooth afterwards with an implant or a bridge usually costs more than the root canal treatment would have. Keeping your own tooth is generally the better long-term option where it is realistic.

Front teeth occasionally discolour after root canal treatment. Where that happens, there are options to address it, which Dr Meg can discuss.

Outcomes depend heavily on the individual tooth, the anatomy of the canals, how much infection is present and how the tooth is restored afterwards. Dr Meg will give you a realistic assessment for your tooth rather than a general figure.

Often on back teeth, less often on front teeth. It is assessed case by case based on how much sound tooth structure remains.

fields.label: Main heading
fields.value: Keeping a tooth you would rather not lose.

fields.label: Introduction
fields.value: Root canal treatment has an unfortunate reputation, largely built on how the procedure was done decades ago and on the pain people were in before they had it. In practice it is the treatment that saves teeth that would otherwise have to come out.

fields.label: Introduction
fields.value: Inside every tooth is a chamber containing nerve and blood vessels. When bacteria reach that chamber — through deep decay, a crack, trauma, or under a failing restoration — the tissue becomes inflamed and then infected. It does not recover on its own. Root canal treatment removes the infected tissue, disinfects and shapes the canals, and seals them so bacteria cannot re-establish.

fields.label: Small heading
fields.value: Signs you may need it

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Severe or throbbing toothache, particularly at night

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Pain that lingers well after something hot or cold

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Pain on biting or when the tooth is touched

fields.label: List item
fields.value: A tooth that has darkened

fields.label: List item
fields.value: A tender swelling or a small pimple on the gum near the tooth

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Facial swelling, which should be seen promptly

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Pain that stops on its own is not reassurance. It often means the nerve has died, and the infection is continuing without a nerve to signal it.

fields.label: Small heading
fields.value: Treatment here

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Dr Meg carries out root canal treatment including on molars, which are more complex because of the number and curvature of their canals. That capability came from years in regional practice, where referring every case to an endodontist in a capital city was not realistic for patients.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Some cases are genuinely better handled by an endodontist — unusual anatomy, calcified canals, a previously treated tooth that needs redoing, or a case with complications. Where that is true, she will tell you and arrange the referral rather than pressing on.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Where a 3D view of the roots is needed for planning, CBCT imaging is available on site.

fields.label: Small heading
fields.value: What is involved

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Treatment is carried out under local anaesthetic. The tooth is isolated with a rubber dam to keep it clean and dry, an opening is made, and the canals are cleaned, shaped and disinfected. Depending on the tooth and how much infection is present, this may be completed in one appointment or across two, sometimes with a medicated dressing in between.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Once the canals are clean, they are sealed and the tooth is restored. A back tooth that has had root canal treatment has usually lost a good deal of structure and becomes more brittle, so a crown is often recommended to protect it from fracture.

fields.label: Small heading
fields.value: Afterwards

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Tenderness on biting for a few days is common as the surrounding tissue settles, and ordinary pain relief usually manages it. Severe or increasing pain, or swelling, is worth phoning about.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: The tooth is then reviewed to confirm the surrounding bone is healing.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Frequently asked questions

fields.label: Button words
fields.value: Does root canal treatment hurt?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: The treatment is done under local anaesthetic and most people find the appointment much easier than the toothache that brought them in. Everyone is different and no dentist can promise a completely pain-free appointment, but the procedure itself is not the ordeal its reputation suggests.

fields.label: Button words
fields.value: How many appointments will I need?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: One or two for the root canal itself, depending on the tooth and the degree of infection, plus a further appointment if a crown is planned. Molars generally take longer than front teeth.

fields.label: Button words
fields.value: Would it be cheaper to just pull the tooth out?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Extraction costs less on the day. Replacing the tooth afterwards with an implant or a bridge usually costs more than the root canal treatment would have. Keeping your own tooth is generally the better long-term option where it is realistic.

fields.label: Button words
fields.value: Will the tooth go dark?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Front teeth occasionally discolour after root canal treatment. Where that happens, there are options to address it, which Dr Meg can discuss.

fields.label: Button words
fields.value: How successful is root canal treatment?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Outcomes depend heavily on the individual tooth, the anatomy of the canals, how much infection is present and how the tooth is restored afterwards. Dr Meg will give you a realistic assessment for your tooth rather than a general figure.

fields.label: Button words
fields.value: Do I definitely need a crown afterwards?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Often on back teeth, less often on front teeth. It is assessed case by case based on how much sound tooth structure remains.
